properties.description:
crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_capability_can_state_what_it_takes_and_gives.rs.

The first probe restates the DEFECT as a test before testing the fix: it asserts `add_capability` writes no signature, so the 0-of-170 measurement is pinned rather than remembered.

Four mutations, each caught: outputs never written; replace-instead-of-merge; an unknown capability created rather than refused; an empty list treated as 'nobody said'. The fourth was run twice — the first attempt was a `sed` whose delimiter collided with a `|` in the pattern, so it silently changed nothing and the green result meant nothing. Redone in python, it failed exactly the empty-list probe.

EXERCISED ON THE LIVE SURFACE TOO: three capabilities built this session were given real signatures through the MCP tool, and a deliberate typo was refused by the running binary.
properties.findings: 5 probes pass, 4 mutations each caught. Used on the live surface: three capabilities now carry signatures, taking Capability.inputs from 0 of 170 to 3.
properties.name: Five probes: the signature is writable at all, one half never erases the other, what the capability already said survives, a typo is refused, and an empty list is a statement rather than a silence
